name: Touchstone
description: A Legacy artifact used to deactivate Karn and an aboroth.

description_citations.text: "The Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vuel steals the Legacy and deactivates Karn with the Touchstone.
timeline.quote: deactivating him with the Touchstone while he was distracted

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard defeats the aboroth with the Thran Forge and the Touchstone.
timeline.quote: Gerrard turned the aboroth into metal pieces with the Thran forge and then deactivated it with the Touchstone

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke gives Vuel the Touchstone and urges revenge.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath steals many of Gerrard's original artifacts to thwart his destiny; the Touchstone is the first lost.
timeline.quote: stolen by his adopted brother Volrath

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Touchstone is used to deactivate Karn, who stands as a statue for 11 years before the crew picks him up in 4204 AR.
timeline.quote: Karn stood as a statue for 11 years

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard reactivates Karn and takes the Touchstone from his hand.
timeline.quote: Gerrard then found a way to reactivate Karn and plucked the Touchstone from his opening grasp.

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Llanowar Gerrard uses the Thran Forge and Touchstone to turn an aboroth into dust, showing Tahngarth his connection to the Legacy.
timeline.quote: This is what made Tahngarth realize the special connection Gerrard had with the Legacy artifacts.

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
